requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests validating binary normalization outputs map strictly to 0 or 1.
The system must include unit tests validating categorical normalization maps predefined categories to expected numeric scores.
The system must include unit tests validating continuous normalization produces values within the defined scale (e.g., 0–1).
The system must validate min-max normalization produces correct outputs for known input ranges.
The system must validate z-score normalization produces expected standardized values for known datasets.
The system must include tests confirming normalization outputs conform to the schema defined in EVAL-NORM-SCHEMA-001.
The system must include integration tests verifying normalized outputs are accepted without error by scoring inputs.
The system must include integration tests confirming normalization is invoked via the internal API before scoring execution.
The system must include tests validating consistent normalization results across repeated executions with identical inputs.
The system must include tests verifying configuration-driven mappings are correctly applied per measure.
The system must include tests validating handling of missing input values results in a defined fallback or error response.
The system must include tests validating out-of-range input values trigger controlled normalization behavior or error handling.
The system must include exception tests verifying invalid measure types are rejected with a defined error.
The system must include exception tests verifying malformed input payloads fail schema validation.
The system must ensure all normalization tests are executable via the existing pytest framework without errors.
